E002 and E034 are distinct external interpretation and primary legal records.","favorable_and_adverse_search":"Adverse evidence is substantial. reported policy acts and outcomes do not establish broad governing effectiveness."]}],"global_findings":["Research rounds were exhausted without full saturation; this is a terminal research conclusion, not a claim that the dossier is complete.","The final handoff preserves material residual gaps in attribution, contrary evidence, source quality, temporal fit, event coverage, implementation, durability, and personal-integrity nexus.","Later rounds improved precise locator coverage, but earlier retained material still includes imprecise or gateway-level locators requiring deterministic repair or extraction.","Evidence counts are reduced for blocked, discovery-only, duplicated, bundled, allegation-only, official-only, and non-attributable material; source counts are not treated as event counts.","Local facts are retained as population, exposure, institutional, inherited-baseline, or country context and are not automatically attributed to Prayut.","Missing evidence is treated as uncertainty and an interpretation limitation, never as negative ruler evidence.","No researcher-written scores, score ranges, anchors, rankings, or judge advice were identified.","Chapter 7B remains the strongest attribution blocker because no admissible target-period personal-integrity nexus was recovered.","No continuation is requested or selected because this is the terminal review after all permitted research rounds."],"needs_continuation":false,"reviewer_summary":"Terminal evidence-quality review completed for all eight selected chapters.
